# データベーススキーマ（自動生成）

<!-- Generated by `python -m common.schema_doc` from common/models.py. Do not edit. -->

`common/models.py` から生成した列レベルの ER 図。**手で編集しない。**モデルを変更したら `backend/` で `python -m common.schema_doc` を実行する。設計の意図は [4_Database.md](../specification/2_Technical_Details/4_Database.md) にある。

列の注記: `nullable` は NULL を許す列、`unique(...)` は複合一意制約。他の領域のテーブルは、外部キーの参照先として列なしで描かれる。

## グラフ本体

ネットワークとその構造。サブグラフは親を指す独立したネットワークとして複製される。

```mermaid
erDiagram
    networks |o--o{ networks : "parent_network_id"
    networks ||--o{ nodes : "network_id"
    networks ||--o{ edges : "network_id"
    nodes ||--o{ edges : "source_node_id"
    nodes ||--o{ edges : "target_node_id"
    networks {
        INTEGER id PK
        STRING name
        DATETIME created_at "nullable"
        DATETIME updated_at "nullable"
        TEXT description "nullable"
        BOOLEAN is_directed
        STRING last_layout_name "nullable"
        JSON last_node_size_config "nullable"
        JSON last_node_color_config "nullable"
        JSON last_edge_width_config "nullable"
        JSON last_edge_color_config "nullable"
        JSON last_node_label_config "nullable"
        JSON last_highlight_config "nullable"
        INTEGER parent_network_id FK "nullable"
    }
    nodes {
        INTEGER id PK
        INTEGER network_id FK, UK "unique(network_id, node_id)"
        STRING node_id UK "unique(network_id, node_id)"
        STRING label "nullable"
        DATETIME created_at "nullable"
        DATETIME updated_at "nullable"
    }
    edges {
        INTEGER id PK
        INTEGER network_id FK, UK "unique(network_id, edge_id)"
        STRING edge_id UK "unique(network_id, edge_id)"
        INTEGER source_node_id FK
        INTEGER target_node_id FK
        FLOAT weight "nullable"
        DATETIME created_at "nullable"
        DATETIME updated_at "nullable"
    }
```

## 属性

属性の定義（名前・型・意味・由来）と値。値は格納型ごとの子テーブルに分かれる。ノード側とエッジ側は同じ形をとる。

```mermaid
erDiagram
    networks ||--o{ node_attributes : "network_id"
    nodes ||--o{ node_attribute_values : "node_id"
    node_attributes ||--o{ node_attribute_values : "attribute_id"
    node_attribute_values ||--o| node_float_attribute_values : "node_attribute_value_id"
    node_attribute_values ||--o| node_text_attribute_values : "node_attribute_value_id"
    networks ||--o{ edge_attributes : "network_id"
    edges ||--o{ edge_attribute_values : "edge_id"
    edge_attributes ||--o{ edge_attribute_values : "attribute_id"
    edge_attribute_values ||--o| edge_float_attribute_values : "edge_attribute_value_id"
    edge_attribute_values ||--o| edge_text_attribute_values : "edge_attribute_value_id"
    node_attributes {
        INTEGER id PK
        INTEGER network_id FK, UK "unique(network_id, attribute_name)"
        STRING attribute_name UK "unique(network_id, attribute_name)"
        STRING data_type "nullable"
        TEXT description "nullable"
        DATETIME created_at "nullable"
        DATETIME updated_at "nullable"
        BOOLEAN is_derived
        STRING derived_from "nullable"
        JSON computation_params "nullable"
        STRING graph_state_hash "nullable"
        DATETIME computed_at "nullable"
        STRING role "data | metric | community | coordinate"
        STRING measurement "nullable; categorical | discrete | quantitative | identifier | text"
    }
    node_attribute_values {
        INTEGER id PK
        INTEGER node_id FK, UK "unique(node_id, attribute_id)"
        INTEGER attribute_id FK, UK "unique(node_id, attribute_id)"
        DATETIME created_at "nullable"
        DATETIME updated_at "nullable"
    }
    node_float_attribute_values {
        INTEGER node_attribute_value_id PK, FK
        FLOAT float_value "nullable"
    }
    node_text_attribute_values {
        INTEGER node_attribute_value_id PK, FK
        TEXT text_value "nullable"
    }
    edge_attributes {
        INTEGER id PK
        INTEGER network_id FK, UK "unique(network_id, attribute_name)"
        STRING attribute_name UK "unique(network_id, attribute_name)"
        STRING data_type "nullable"
        TEXT description "nullable"
        DATETIME created_at "nullable"
        DATETIME updated_at "nullable"
        BOOLEAN is_derived
        STRING derived_from "nullable"
        JSON computation_params "nullable"
        STRING graph_state_hash "nullable"
        DATETIME computed_at "nullable"
        STRING role "data | metric | community | coordinate"
        STRING measurement "nullable; categorical | discrete | quantitative | identifier | text"
    }
    edge_attribute_values {
        INTEGER id PK
        INTEGER edge_id FK, UK "unique(edge_id, attribute_id)"
        INTEGER attribute_id FK, UK "unique(edge_id, attribute_id)"
        DATETIME created_at "nullable"
        DATETIME updated_at "nullable"
    }
    edge_float_attribute_values {
        INTEGER edge_attribute_value_id PK, FK
        FLOAT float_value "nullable"
    }
    edge_text_attribute_values {
        INTEGER edge_attribute_value_id PK, FK
        TEXT text_value "nullable"
    }
```

## 利用者と会話

利用者・チャット・メッセージと、エージェントの実行記録・トークン使用量。

```mermaid
erDiagram
    users ||--o{ chats : "user_id"
    networks ||--o| chats : "network_id"
    chats ||--o{ chat_messages : "chat_id"
    chat_messages ||--o{ tool_executions : "message_id"
    chat_messages |o--o| llm_usages : "message_id"
    chats |o--o{ llm_usages : "chat_id"
    users |o--o{ llm_usages : "user_id"
    users {
        INTEGER id PK
        STRING username UK
        STRING hashed_password
        INTEGER token_version
        STRING default_provider "nullable"
        STRING default_model "nullable"
        DATETIME created_at "nullable"
        DATETIME updated_at "nullable"
    }
    chats {
        INTEGER id PK
        STRING name
        INTEGER user_id FK
        INTEGER network_id FK, UK
        DATETIME created_at "nullable"
        DATETIME updated_at "nullable"
        JSON visualization_state "nullable"
        STRING provider "nullable"
        STRING model "nullable"
        BOOLEAN name_is_custom
    }
    chat_messages {
        INTEGER id PK
        INTEGER chat_id FK
        STRING role
        TEXT content
        JSON meta_data "nullable"
        DATETIME created_at "nullable"
        DATETIME updated_at "nullable"
    }
    tool_executions {
        INTEGER id PK
        INTEGER message_id FK
        STRING tool_name
        JSON arguments "nullable"
        JSON result "nullable"
        TEXT thought "nullable"
        STRING status
        TEXT error "nullable"
        STRING call_id "nullable"
        TEXT thought_signature "nullable"
        DATETIME created_at "nullable"
        DATETIME started_at "nullable"
        DATETIME completed_at "nullable"
    }
    llm_usages {
        INTEGER id PK
        INTEGER message_id FK, UK "nullable"
        INTEGER chat_id FK "nullable"
        INTEGER user_id FK "nullable"
        STRING purpose
        STRING provider
        STRING model
        INTEGER input_tokens
        INTEGER output_tokens
        INTEGER cached_input_tokens
        INTEGER cache_write_tokens
        INTEGER reasoning_tokens
        INTEGER iteration_count
        JSON calls "nullable"
        FLOAT estimated_cost_usd "nullable"
        DATETIME created_at "nullable"
    }
```

## 会話中の入力

利用者への質問（ask_user）とパラメータ調整パネル。どちらも回答を待つ間、状態を保持する。

```mermaid
erDiagram
    chats ||--o{ analysis_inputs : "chat_id"
    networks ||--o{ analysis_inputs : "network_id"
    chats ||--o{ parameter_tunings : "chat_id"
    networks ||--o{ parameter_tunings : "network_id"
    analysis_inputs {
        STRING id PK
        INTEGER chat_id FK
        INTEGER network_id FK
        JSON specification
        STRING status
        JSON answer "nullable"
        JSON activated_tools "nullable"
        DATETIME created_at "nullable"
    }
    parameter_tunings {
        STRING id PK
        INTEGER chat_id FK
        INTEGER network_id FK
        JSON specification
        JSON steps
        JSON values
        JSON initial_values
        JSON suggested_values
        JSON history
        JSON last_result "nullable"
        STRING status
        JSON activated_tools "nullable"
        DATETIME last_applied_at "nullable"
        DATETIME reported_at "nullable"
        DATETIME confirmed_at "nullable"
        DATETIME created_at "nullable"
    }
```
